meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把演示主题或现成网页变成可点击跳转的分支幻灯片,自带讲者备注
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做一份能点击跳转、带讲者备注的演示,而普通幻灯片不够用
copy.tagline_en: Turn a topic or web page into a branching clickable deck with speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clickable deck with speaker notes that plain slides can't deliver

howto.what: Claude 会把内容写成 HyperFrames 幻灯片:离散页面、片段逐步显示、热点分支和演讲者备注,产出用 present 播放的可导航 deck,而不是 MP4;也能把已有网页转成 deck。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做 slideshow 时触发;若从 presentation、pitch deck 等相邻请求进来,它会先问你确认,没点头就不动手。

say.text: 把这个页面转成幻灯片 deck
say.note: 尽量保留原页面的设计和动效

howto.what_en: Claude authors HyperFrames slideshows: discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching, speaker notes. Output is a navigable deck played with `hyperframes present`, not an MP4; existing pages can also be converted into a deck.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow. From adjacent requests like presentation or pitch deck, it asks a yes/no confirmation first and won't build until you say yes.

say_en.text: Turn this into a HyperFrames slideshow
Convert this page into a slide deck
say_en.note: Tries to keep the page's design and motion.
